title: astracantha schottiana
intro: Astracantha schottiana, commonly known as Thorny Acacia or Schott's Astracantha, is a spiny shrub or small tree that belongs to the legume family (Fabaceae). It is traditionally used in herbal medicine for its health benefits, including the treatment of fever, rheumatism, and digestive issues. The plant's therapeutic actions are attributed to its ability to stimulate circulation, reduce inflammation, and exhibit antimicrobial properties. The bioactive constituents of Astracantha schottiana include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and alkaloids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
